title: gossypium timorense
intro: Gossypium timorense, commonly known as the Timor cotton tree or Timor cotton, is a plant species within the Malvaceae family. It is native to the islands of Timor and Sumba in Indonesia and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Gossypium timorense include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protective effects.
